authorization_record: User instructed Aurex to continue with finesse while remaining grounded in truth, facts, and reality after selecting Readiness Closure as the next stage.
purpose: Determine whether Aurex is a reusable, fail-closed strategy research factory before any new strategy mechanism is designed.

gate_specs.requirement: One canonical checkpoint must state current strategy, authority, and profit truth.
Protocols, results, audits, and ledgers must be schema-validated and hash-bound.
Historical inputs must have source identity, continuity, quality, and no-synthesis controls.
Consumed periods and retired lineages must be immutable and development/validation/holdout roles isolated.
A durable protocol must be committed before any candidate outcome is recorded.
Replays and audits must reproduce trades, metrics, and decisions deterministically.
Every future candidate promotion contract must require cost stress, uncertainty, multiplicity, concentration, regime, and chronological evidence.
Lifecycle state must be machine-enforced so retired or quarantined strategies cannot be re-enabled or promoted.
Paper execution must require accepted protocol-bound evidence and matching signal provenance.
Webhook authentication, exact-body evidence, idempotency, and one genuine external safe-rejection proof must exist.
Paper fills, costs, positions, PnL, and imported evidence must reconcile under explicit assumptions.
Position sizing, account/session limits, stale-signal rejection, and durable kill controls must fail closed.
Authenticated order, fill, fee, balance, stream, restart, idempotency, and soak evidence must be independently reconciled.
Production execution must remain unavailable until a separately implemented adapter, evidence gates, and explicit approval pass.
The API and UI must expose current platform readiness, blockers, authority, and next action without stale hard-coded strategy claims.

limitations: Code presence is capability evidence, not proof of profitable operation.
External TradingView delivery remains unproven until genuine evidence exists.
No readiness score can create or imply a profitable strategy.
Production legality, account verification, and real-capital approval remain external blockers.
The audit may inspect source and existing evidence but may not open a market outcome.
